website_summary.name: E-Government Office Management System
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and structured interface designed with a light pink background and medium violet red elements for key components, providing an organized display for office management functions.
website_summary.appearance: The E-Government Office Management System consists of a well-structured layout. On the left side of the screen, there's a vertical navigation menu with options such as Home, Modules, Applications, Approvals, Queries, and Reports. Each option is accompanied by a distinct icon and text. The main content area displays the Home page prominently, featuring three sections: Quick Actions, Recent Activity, and Statistics. The Quick Actions section provides buttons for functions like submitting leave requests, cadre leaving requests, attendance, and power requests. The Recent Activity section is currently empty, indicating no recent updates. The Statistics section lists counts of different types of requests (leave, cadre leaving, attendance, and power) with values of "0" next to each. The top of the main content area has a search bar for easy navigation and functional icons for notifications and user profile access.
website_summary.functionality: The website includes several key functionalities. Users can navigate through various modules like Modules, Applications, Approvals, Queries, and Reports via the sidebar menu. The search bar at the top enables users to search for specific information within the system. Under the Home section, users can quickly perform essential actions like submitting different types of requests by clicking the corresponding buttons. User profile customization and notification viewing are available via icons in the top-right corner. The Recent Activity and Statistics sections provide an overview of recent and past activities within the system. Despite the current display showing no recent activity and all statistics set as '0', these sections imply that when data is present, they will facilitate tracking and monitoring of relevant activities.

functionality_testing.name: Leave Application Form Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that filling out the leave application form and submitting it increments the leave request count in the Statistics section.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Name, Department, Leave Type, Start Date, End Date, Reason, Submit Application
functionality_testing.preconditions: The user is on the leave application form page.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The leave request count in the Statistics section should be incremented by one, and the leave application should be successfully submitted. 7. Next Steps : Fill out the leave application form and submit the leave request.
procedure: Fill in the Name textbox with "John Doe".
Fill in the Department textbox with "Engineering".
Select "Annual Leave" from the Leave Type dropdown.
Fill in the Start Date textbox with "01/01/2023".
Fill in the End Date textbox with "01/05/2023".
Fill in the Reason textarea with "Vacation".
Click on the Submit Application button.
Verify that the leave request count in the Statistics section has incremented by one.

functionality_testing.name: Leave Application Form Validation Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the leave application form validates required fields and prevents submission until all required fields are filled out.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Name, Department, Leave Type, Start Date, End Date, Reason, Submit Application
functionality_testing.preconditions: The user is on the leave application form page with the "Name" field filled out.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The form validation error message should appear next to the "Department" field when attempting to submit the form without filling it out. After filling out the "Department" field, the form should be submitted successfully and the leave request count in the Statistics section should be incremented by one. 7. Next Steps : Fill out the "Department" field with "Engineering".
procedure: Attempt to click on the Submit Application button without filling out the "Department" field.
Verify that a form validation error message appears next to the "Department" field.
Fill in the Department textbox with "Engineering".
Click on the Submit Application button again.
Verify that the form is submitted successfully and the leave request count in the Statistics section is incremented by one.
